Rooms.Name: Cave entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the cave entrance. It is very dark down here.
There is writing at the wall. There is an exit to the north. A stairway
leads up.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see a small tunnel.
You can see the stairs going up into darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The writing says 'BEWARE adventurer!'

Rooms.Name: Cave tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are walking in a tunnel. It is very cold. You can feel the
presence of a living thing ... SOMEWHERE.

Exits.Description: To the north you can see the tunnel continuing.
To the south tunnel continuing.

Rooms.Name: Cave room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a room. It's much cooler now. The walls are
glowing.

Exits.Description: To the east you see the tunnel going downwards.
To the south you see a dark cave tunnel.

Rooms.Name: Cave T-cross
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a mudlike substance. The smell here is awful, it
is rotten. To the west you can see some light.

Exits.Description: To the east the tunnel still goes downwards.
You can see some light to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: When you examine the mud, you notice small worms crawling around.
The worms are purple.  They do not look edible.

Rooms.Name: Cave turning-point
Rooms.Description:
The mud are getting deeper. You are wondering, 'Would it be an idea
to leave, before I disappear?'. To the south you notice a flat round
stone are blocking the way. To the west you can see mud.

Exits.Description: You can see an opening behind the stone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stone looks very uninteresting.  BUT as you are about to turn away,
you see a light stripe coming through a small hole.  Conclusion: The
stone is moveable.

Rooms.Name: The secret room
Rooms.Description:
There is dust all over the place. It looks like nobody has been here
for ages. In the middle of the room you see a socket with a crystal
globe. The globe glows with a pulsing light. To the north you see a
stone door. To the south you see a gray block.

Exits.Description: You see a round stone door.
You see a gray block

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The socket looks like the work of a dwarf.  It is VERY beautiful.

The crystal globe is glowing with a pulsing light. It looks like there
is smoke inside it.

Rooms.Name: The mudhole
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a lot of mud. The mud goes to your chest. You
feel the presence of something IN the mud. The only obvious exit is to
the west.

Exits.Description: You can see nothing at all.

Rooms.Name: Tunnel
Rooms.Description: The mud goes to your knees. Otherwise the tunnel looks very normal.

Exits.Description: You can see a mudhole.

Rooms.Name: The long tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Here there is almost no mud, as you stand at the top of a small
rock. Just beside you there are a sign which says 'WARNING! The worms
are dangerous!'.

Exits.Description: You can see a lot of mud... Yuck!
The tunnel goes a little downwards.

Rooms.Name: The hot room
Rooms.Description:
You are very surprised, as this room for a change are hot instead of
cold. To the north it goes downwards into some mud. There are also an
exit to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a lot of mud.
You see a entrance to a small room.

Rooms.Name: The small room
Rooms.Description:
As you look around you notice a small statue. There are exits to the
west and to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a VERY long hallway.
It is pitch dark out there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a statue of a imp, pointing to the west.  The imp looks like a
man with horns and a tail.

Rooms.Name: The stalagmite cave
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a stalagmite cave. Water is dripping from the
walls. It is very cold in here.

Exits.Description: You see a long hallway, and some mud.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The stalagmites are very tall, and looks very beautiful.

Rooms.Name: The stalagmite tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You has entered a small tunnel. Here it is quite dry. Maybe it would
be a good idea to rest here.

Exits.Description: You can see a small cave to the north.

Rooms.Name: The spongy room
Rooms.Description:
You definitely NOT like this area. It is very dank, and in most of
the room it is wet.

Rooms.Name: The stalagmite T-cross
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a cross. To the north you can see some light.
Otherwise it is dark.

Exits.Description: You see some light ahead.

Rooms.Name: The blind end room
Rooms.Description:
This room is obviously a blind end. To the north you see a primitive
picture.

Exits.Description: You see a primitive picture.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You see some people dancing around a huge sun.  The sun is about 7 feet
in diameter, which shows the size of the picture.

Rooms.Name: The treasure room
Rooms.Description:
This room is richly ornamented. The walls has been carved to show
people dancing around a sun which is drawn on the floor. It looks very
old, and it is very dusty. To the south you see a secret door.

Exits.Description: You can see a picture with some persons crawling around a huge moon.

Rooms.Name: The square lair
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the south-east part of the lair. You can see a
skeleton lying in the corner.

Exits.Description: Another part of the lair.
Another part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like a adventurer who wasn't lucky.  You'd better watch out...

Rooms.Name: The square lair
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the north-east part of the lair. You see a sign
on the wall.

Exits.Description: You see a wooden door.
Another part of the lair.
Another part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign says 'Gods of War I call you, my sword is by my side,
               I seek a light free from all false pride'
                       Reyemle Grug.....

Rooms.Name: The square lair
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the north-west part of the lair. Here there is
another sign. There is an exit from the lair to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a small tunnel leading north.
Another part of the lair.
Another part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign says 'I'm wandering around in a everlasting tale,
               seeking the light to regain my pride
                           Corama...

Rooms.Name: The lair end
Rooms.Description:
You can see a table in front of you. It's very dusty. Five skeletons
are sitting around the table. Exits are north and east.

Exits.Description: The northern part of the lair.
The eastern part of the lair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On the table there is dust, in the center there is a small statue of a
Dragon sleeping.

They've obviously been killed somehow, but it doesn't look like it was
by sword or club.

It looks like a silver dragon.  It is nailed onto the table.  The
dragon sits on a red dragon that looks dead.  But the eyes of the red
dragon are glowing, pulsating red.  You feel drained.

Rooms.Name: East tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in dark tunnel, the exits are east and west. To the
west you see a wooden door.

Exits.Description: You can see a wooden door.
You can see a muddy tunnel.

Rooms.Name: North tunnel
Rooms.Description: You are standing in a dark tunnel, it leads upwards.

Exits.Description: The dark tunnel continues.
You can see the lair.
You can see a cave entrance.

Rooms.Name: The L-shaped room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in deep darkness. To the south there is a small
exit. To the east you can see a gaping hole.

Rooms.Name: The Circular hall
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in round hall. To the north, east and south you can
see a stone head hanging on the walls.

Exits.Description: you see a room far away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
When you study the faces of the heads you see that they are faces of
dragons. The face to the north is red, the face to the east is green,
and the face to the south is blue.
This looks like an evil dragon.
This looks like a neutral dragon.
This looks like a good dragon.

Rooms.Name: Dusty tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in dust. This place has not been touched for a long
time. Otherwise it is quite boring here, looks like a place to rest! To
the west you see the outline of a door. A tunnel leads to the east.

Exits.Description: You can see the outline of a door. Just like in the description!
You see a tunnel which leads downwards. It is quite dark.

Rooms.Name: The crossing
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a crossing of hallways. You can leave this place
in every direction, except up and down. In the dust you notice strange
footprints.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You have never seen this kind of footprints before!

Rooms.Name: The L-shaped room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a L-shaped room. You can hear noises from the
long tunnel to the east. You feel very afraid! A sign is hanging on the
wall.

Exits.Description: a long dark tunnel.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sign says 'DANGER!!'.

Rooms.Name: Dragons lair
Rooms.Description:
You can see burned walls, the floor stones are fiery red. All kinds
of bones are scattered all over the floor. On the walls you can see
some burned shapes. You smell burnt flesh. Two creatures are sort of
melted into the floor.

Exits.Description: You can see a long tunnel.
You can see nothing but darkness.

Rooms.Name: The burned room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a room, which once had been quite burned. There is
writing on the wall.

Exits.Description: You can see a red glow...

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The writing says 'DANGER!!!'

Rooms.Name: The wind tunnel
Rooms.Description: You are standing in a tunnel. Above you, you can feel a breeze.

Exits.Description: To dark to tell

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The breeze comes from a hole above you.  NO way to get up there.

Rooms.Name: The glittering room
Rooms.Description:
This room are all bright. In the walls you can see some silver.
Exits are west, east and south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The glittering silver looks like it is INSIDE the walls.

Rooms.Name: The secret passage room
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a tiny room. There is an exit down, and an exit to
the west.

Exits.Description: You can see a light to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A sign is blocking the way. It says 'This has not been implemented
yet....'

Rooms.Name: End of long tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are at a end of a long tunnel. Right in front of you, you can
see a gray mass. To the east you can see a tremendously long tunnel,
but you know that, you were just there.

Exits.Description: A long tunnel. JUST like in the description!
A gray mass is blocking the way.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The mass is nothing but a mass, but it is quite suspicious!

Rooms.Name: Stair-room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small room. Drawings of faces in pain are on
the walls. You can fell darkness is ruling the place. There are two
exits: south and down.  But apparently the exit down is blocked and
impossible to get by.

Exits.Description: Nothing but darkness...
A sign is blocking the way: 'This has not been implemented yet'.

Rooms.Name: Dark tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dark tunnel. It continues to the north and to
the south. Bones are spread on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like bones of a human.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to lair
Rooms.Description:
The smell here is awful. To the south you can see some smoke. A
tunnel leads north and east.

Exits.Description: The only thing you can see is smoke.
A small cave is to the east.

Rooms.Name: North-eastern part of Basilisk's cave
Rooms.Description:
It is hard to see here because of the smoke. To the north you can
barely see a small tunnel. Other exits are to the south and to the
west.

Rooms.Name: South-eastern part of Basilisk's cave
Rooms.Description:
There are a very small hole in wall from which the smoke is coming
from. Otherwise it is pitch black. Exits are north and west.

Exits.Description: You can see nothing but smoke.
You can see nothing but smoke.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It's a small hole, about one foot in diameter.

Rooms.Name: North-western part of Basilisk's cave
Rooms.Description:
You can see some hay spread on the floor. The smell is awful here,
and it makes you feel sick. This place where the Basilisk sleeps. Watch
out... maybe it is not far from here..

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The hay is very dirty.  The smell of it makes you feel sick.

Rooms.Name: South-western part of Basilisk's cave
Rooms.Description: You can see nothing but smoke.

Rooms.Name: The small cave
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in small cave. You can see some light at the end.
Exits are north and south.

Exits.Description: You can see only smoke.
You can see a blue glow. And you feel a fresh breeze.... ahhhh....

Rooms.Name: The northern end of the pool
Rooms.Description:
You have wet feet, you are standing in water. The water looks calm.
You can see that it's a big lake. Light seeps from the water.

Exits.Description: You can see a small cave.
You can see more water.
You can see water.

Rooms.Name: The pool
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming in water. It is getting deep here. It is also dark
in this end.

Exits.Description: You see calm water.
You can see some bubbles in the water.

Rooms.Name: The south end of the pool
Rooms.Description: You standing in water up to your neck! You can only see water.

Exits.Description: You can see calm water.
To dark to tell, but you can feel something nearby.

Rooms.Name: The pool
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming in DARKNESS. You feel something touching your right
leg.

Exits.Description: To dark to tell.
You can feel a warm breeze.

Mobs.Name: chr-eff'n chr
Mobs.LongDescription: The chr-eff'n are crawling here, looking around with its yellow eyes.
Mobs.Description:
The head and torso of a chr-eff'n is copper-covered, with yellow,
glowing eyes.  The lower body is in an orange shading.

Mobs.Name: red dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The Red fierce-looking dragon stares at you angrily.
Mobs.Description:
The red dragon stares at you, angrily, as it wakes when you arrive.  It says
'Oh, human YOU woke me up...Hsssss', while it moves closer, 'Can one NEVER
sleep in peace...Hssss'.

Mobs.Name: sea hag
Mobs.LongDescription: The Sea Hag is here, swimming around.
Mobs.Description:
The sea hag is so ghastly looking that you feel the deepest fear: Big yellow
eyes and sharp teeth.  Its ears are very big, and it has small sharp horns.
This type of monster is one of the greatest haters of beauty (next after
Medusa).

Mobs.Name: guardian naga
Mobs.LongDescription: The Guardian Naga looks kindly at you.
Mobs.Description:
The naga are a snake-liked creature.  She is covered in green-gold scales with
silvery triangles along her back.  Her eyes are golden.  She notices that you
are staring at her, and she says: 'Watch out.  This way leads to some evil
creatures'.

Mobs.Name: scaled basilisk
Mobs.LongDescription: The scaled Basilisk crawls towards you slowly.
Mobs.Description:
The basilisk is a reptilian monster.  It has eight legs, and a strong, toothy
jaws.  It is dull brown with yellowish underbelly.  Its eyes are glowing pale
green.

Mobs.Name: lemure blob
Mobs.LongDescription: The lemure blob slithers towards you for an attack!
Mobs.Description:
This looks like a vaguely human blob.  Big black yellow eyes, and a mouth going
a little bit out from the face.  The lemure does not look interested in you at
all, but it attacks anyway.  It looks like its mind has been burned out.

Mobs.Name: jones cruncher ettin
Mobs.LongDescription: Jones is standing here glaring at you.
Mobs.Description:
At the first sight you thought Jones was an Orc, but when it came closer you
saw his second head.  He wears an animal skin dress, filthy and moth eaten. 
Jones really stinks...

Mobs.Name: herald mouse killer ettin
Mobs.LongDescription: Herald is standing here looking confused at you.
Mobs.Description:
When you look at Herald, you feel petty.  His clothes are really poor, and one
of his heads hangs down.  At the rope around his stomach hangs dead mice and
rats.  He does not smell good.
